repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmRY38EZf38Yy3zthbY

## 维护者速读

卡的前提有一处不成立：Studio 里已经有「对外表单」页（开发者 → Public Forms），能列出已发布的、复制地址、打开、发布现有表单、改共享设置。缺的是：不在设置里、不限管理员、关掉的会从清单消失、不能改字段和标题、不能从零新建、不能删。开工前请定：

- **F1 入口放哪**：A 设置里做成唯一入口，Studio 那一项撤掉（推荐，管理界面只留一处）；B 两处并存。
- **F3 关掉的表单打开时显示什么**：A 和不存在的表单一样，显示「没有这个表单」，验收改成「关掉后打不开、不能提交」（推荐，不让匿名访客知道它存在）；B 显示「此表单已关闭」，要新加错误码。
- **F2**：关于第 5 项还有一个问题，席位另外直接问你，不写在卡上。

另外「最近一次提交时间」现在没有数据（提交记录不记来自哪个表单），按卡上的说法先不做，在 PR 里说明。

要你做的：F1、F3 各选 A 或 B（例如「AA」）。

## Analysis

Reading at main `3b589215` (after #36425 merged), by the card thread for this card; re-checked by the seat.

**Premise correction.** The card says neither the console nor Studio has a public-forms entry. Studio has one: `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/studio.app.ts:324` `nav_public_forms` → `developer:public-forms`, page `ui/apps/console/src/pages/developer/PublicFormsPage.tsx`. It lists published forms, copies and opens the address, publishes an existing form view, and edits the sharing settings and the after-submit behaviour. Missing against the card: it is not under Settings and not admin-only; a switched-off form leaves the list (no way to switch it back on); no field or title editing and no preview; no create from scratch; no delete.

Re-check: `git grep -n nav_public_forms -- packages/platform-objects/src/apps/studio.app.ts`.

**F1 — where the management page lives.**
- A: Settings is the one entry (admin only, as the maintainer ruled: 「对外表单的管理界面 放在设置中」); the Studio entry and its page are retired, and what the page does moves into the Settings page.
- B: both stay.
- Business need: the ask was one place for a customer's admin; nothing reads two entries. Long-term: one operation with two implementations drifts; the governed one (admin-only Settings) should win and the other be deleted. AI-error: one surface means one place for an AI to wire a form's management. Scope: A removes a page, B keeps two to maintain.
- Recommend **A**.

**F3 — what a switched-off form answers.**
- A: keep today's 404 `FORM_NOT_FOUND`, the same as a form that does not exist (deliberate: `FormPage.tsx` around lines 1812–1818 says 「没有这个表单」 for both); acceptance becomes "after switching off, the address does not open and does not accept a submission".
- B: a new `FORM_CLOSED` code and a 「此表单已关闭」 page (`Clause-②: yes`).
- Business need: none measured for telling an anonymous visitor a form exists but is closed. Long-term: A adds no public code. AI-error: neutral. Scope: B adds a public error code and tells an anonymous visitor the slug exists.
- Recommend **A**.

**F2** is asked of the maintainer outside this card.

**Not built, per the card's own wording:** "last submission time": submissions do not record which form they came from.

Governing text: AGENTS.md (one operation, one implementation); the maintainer's 「对外表单的管理界面 放在设置中」 on this card.

The card leaves the active queue for the decision box; its card thread holds the claim until the ruling.

repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmRLP8hu484jg1UR8VB

## 维护者速读

已裁：Studio 负责设计，设置负责运营；交给 objectstack 1 号席继续开发。范围已按此改写（见下），卡回 `pm:queue`，2 号席没有认领。

## Ruling

Ruled: maintainer, project thread, 2026-11-23T11:58Z: 「36444 按 Studio 设计、设置运营，交接给 objectstack 1号座位继续开发」

The ruling picks the design the card thread proposed when the maintainer asked how it works if public forms stay defined in the app (2026-11-23T11:05Z: 「如果我就是希望在应用中定义，要怎么设计？」). It answers the seat's analysis 7087880355 as follows:

- Premise correction stands: Studio already has Developer → Public Forms (`git grep -n nav_public_forms -- packages/platform-objects/src/apps/studio.app.ts`; positive control: `git grep -n group_developer` in the same file).
- F1: neither A nor B as written. The roles split: Studio designs, Settings operates. The Studio page stays and is upgraded; it is not retired.
- F3: A. A switched-off form keeps today's 404 `FORM_NOT_FOUND`, the same as a form that does not exist. No new error code.
- Item 5's access-restriction settings are exposed on neither surface. A security item is with the owner seat.

## Scope as ruled (supersedes 要做的 and 验收 in the body)

**Definition (unchanged shape).** A public form stays what it is today: a `formViews.<name>` entry with `sharing` in the object's view metadata, shipped with the app package (example: `examples/app-crm/src/views/lead.view.ts`, `web_to_lead` → `/forms/contact-us`). No new metadata shape.

**Studio = design (app authors).**
1. Upgrade Studio's Developer → Public Forms page into the public-form designer, placed under the object it belongs to.
2. Create and delete a public form; pick fields from the object (only fields a person can fill: no hidden, read-only, system, roll-up or formula fields); drag to reorder; mark a field required; group into named sections; title and description; after-submit message; the public address (unique, refused with a clear message on a clash).
3. A field the object requires cannot be removed from the form; the editor says why.
4. Live preview of the form beside the settings.
5. Saves go into the app definition through Studio's usual draft → publish path.

**Settings = operations (system administrators only; ordinary members do not see it).**
6. A 「对外表单」 item in Settings listing every public form in the environment: title, object, public address, on/off.
7. Per row: switch on/off, copy address, open a preview in a new tab. No field editing, no create, no delete.
8. Switched-off forms stay in the list and can be switched back on (today they disappear from Studio's list).
9. On/off is saved as this environment's customization, not as an edit to the app package's definition, so app upgrades still flow in.
10. Business wording on both surfaces, no internal names.

**Not built.** "Last submission time": submissions do not record which form they came from; say so in the PR. Plus every 不做的 line in the body.

**Acceptance.**
- A system administrator sees 「对外表单」 in Settings; an ordinary member does not.
- The list shows HotCRM's two public forms with the right title, object and address.
- Switch off 「联系我们」: `/forms/contact-us` opened without signing in shows the not-found state and takes no submission; switch it on: restored. It stays in the list while off.
- In Studio, edit 「联系我们」: make 「电话」 required, remove 「职位」, change the title, publish. Opened without signing in, the changes show and the form refuses a submit without a phone number.
- In Studio, create a public form on 「线索」 with four fields at `demo-signup`, publish. `/forms/demo-signup` takes a submission and a new lead appears.
- An address already in use is refused with a clear message.
- Removing a field the object requires is not allowed, with an explanation.
- The PR body carries screenshots of the Settings list and the Studio designer.

## Hand-over

To: `repo:objectstack#1`, by the ruling above. No `Claim:` was ever written on this card and no branch or code exists, so there is nothing to release beyond this hand-over. The card leaves the decision box for `pm:queue` with no assignee. Seat 2's card thread for it closes now.

Build plan for #36444, 2026-11-23T12:39Z (late: Part 1 was built before the seat's plan request reached this thread; it is open as draft #36697 and follows this plan)

**On/off storage.** The switch is the form's existing `sharing.enabled`. No new key, route or customization kind:
- a form of a writable package is saved and published in that package;
- a form of an installed (read-only) app is saved as a declared override in the app's `.custom` package (ADR-0146 D2/D3), the layer Studio's Customize and the in-page dashboard editor already write. The app's own package is never written, so upgrades flow in;
- switching back on removes that override when it holds nothing but the switch (restore package original); an override that also carries design changes keeps them.
The anonymous routes already withdraw a base form that a per-package override switches off (`anonymousFormIntakeWithdrawnIn`), so a switched-off form keeps today's `404 FORM_NOT_FOUND`. Clause-②: no and Metadata-protocol: none stand as claimed; measured live (see #36697 Acceptance notes).

**PR split.**
1. Settings operations (items 6–10): #36697, `Part of #36444`. New Setup → Configuration → Public Forms page (system administrators), list judged by the server's own intake rule, switch / copy address / open in a new tab.
2. Studio designer (items 1–5): a second PR on the same branch after #36697 lands, `Fixes #36444`. Premise read on the base: the Developer → Public Forms page lives only in the `@objectstack/studio` app, which no example or CLI default loads, so the console's own Studio has no public-forms entry. The designer goes under the object in the console Studio's Data pillar, inside the seven-tab ruling (objectui#12450), saving through Studio's draft → publish. Slug uniqueness is checked in the designer against the served list; the server has no refusal for a duplicate address today, so the refusal message is the designer's.

**Overlap with #36502.** None. #36502 (pm:blocked, no PR) retires Studio's「界面」tab and only points 对外表单 at Settings, which Part 1 provides. Part 1 touches Setup files only; Part 2 sits under the object in the Data pillar, not in「界面」. `overlap-check` on #36697: clean with main, #36629 and #36525; #34223 (draft since 11-19) shares one Setup nav count line in a CLI pin test.
